summary: The Phoenix proposal has successfully implemented a local, append-only event bus system for self-learning agents without altering production weights, verdicts, or trades.
top_technical_reasons: Eliminated the need to mutate agent signatures and trade events by using immutable snapshots with typed research signals.
Implemented an integrity-checking mechanism that ensures only safe events are processed.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Reinforce the event handling logic to support deterministic replay and improved traceability.
next_experiments.change: Modify agent_event_bus.py to include deterministic event replay features.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Performance improvement on existing metrics, e.g., increased accuracy of replayed events.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will demonstrate whether the proposed solution leads to significant performance enhancements without compromising safety or stability.

data_or_label_risks: No new data generation during this implementation process.
